{{Quote|I agree that the Republic has lost its way. I agree that our pleas for relief from oppressive laws and taxes are too often ignored. But the Senate has responded to our complaints. Do you not all agree that if the Jedi can make this peace between the Unity of towns and cities and the Alwari that Ansion will be better off under the laws of the Republic than outside them?|Garil Volune|<ref name="AS" />}}
'''Garil Volune''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] and one of the delegates to the [[Unity Council]]. He was not present at the official [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] greeting on the planet. Instead, he participated in a meeting in the garden of the [[Kandah]] residence, which convinced those present to support the accession of Ansion to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, Volune was loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and urged the Jedi to be given more time to settle the Alwarich affair. During the vote, he voted, like most delegates, for remaining in the Republic.<ref name="AS" />
